description: This file defines a custom exception class SignalEnrichmentFailedException used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends DittoRuntimeException and represents a failure during signal enrichment, including mechanisms for creating instances from JSON, copying with different headers, and attaching causes.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFailedException
classes.description: A custom immutable exception indicating that signal enrichment has failed, with functionality to create from JSON, clone with different headers, or attach causes.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SignalEnrichmentFailedException with a fluent API, supporting setting status, causes, and building the final exception.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new mutable builder instance for SignalEnrichmentFailedException.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SignalEnrichmentFailedException object from a JSON representation, extracting message and status.

methods.name: nextEnrichmentFailedException
methods.description: Creates an exception instance representing failure due to a cause, copying headers, and attaching the cause.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders, maintaining existing message, description, cause, and href.
